full_page.content:
Pg. 26. Handwritten Notes from Retreat.
I. Introduction: "God sent me ... " especially in the lighs of preceding page and what what will follow next page ..... again ..... Deo Gratias!
Monday
I. Obligation to strive for Perfection.
II. Obedience in Role of successful efforts for such perfection. "Not everyone that sayeth Lord Lord shall enter into the Kingdom of Heaven; but he ... "
III. NECESSITY OF FAITH - Need of fostering Same ... One with Hope and Charity. No worthy service without it. "Without it is impossible (for man) to please God."
IV, Mortal Sin .... Most fearful Evil.
Tuesday
I. Venial Sin ... like mortal sin also a most terrible evil, and next to it greatest misfortune possible.
II. Holy Poverty ... Out-standing charkteristic of Seraphic order. Virtue of poverty, by all means to be Fostered.
III. Death .... So Certain! Yet so uncertain! nearly always like thief in the night. Be ready. Why not thank God for death whenever thought of.
Wednesday
I. Judgement - Particular Judg'nt. So all important to be ready for. Like Death itself with which it is so intimately connected - like a thief in the night.
II. CHASTITY. unappreciated because unknown before Mary's advent - Morning Star of Chri __ of Christianity ... Guarded by Mortification.
Pg. 27. Continuation of Page 26.
III. FEAR of the Lord. Beginning of Wisdom. Essential feature in Christian Humility ..... Christian fear - Reverence without .... Scrup
